title: Domino Wonder Dash
one_line: Trace real outlines, topple the dominoes and learn 366 things: ABC, Hindi letters, numbers, animals, maps and more.
how_to_play: Tap once to start. Pick a subject, a category and a picture, trace the dots with your finger or mouse, then tap to topple the dominoes. Next goes to the next one.
description: A learning game for children at NCERT Class 1 to 5 level. Every item has a real dotted outline to trace over a faint picture: A to Z and a to z, the Hindi varnamala (swar and vyanjan, spoken in Hindi where the device has a Hindi voice), numbers, maths signs and shapes, animals, birds, sea life, reptiles, insects, plants, fruits, vegetables, food, body parts, homes and buildings, community helpers, vehicles, bridges, sky and weather, countries on India's official map, Indian states, famous city landmarks and real rivers. When the outline is traced, dominoes stand up on it; tap and they topple, the real picture appears and the name is said, spelled and shown. Sparks fly from every dot, quick tracing builds a musical streak, five colour themes, and a sticker shelf rewards milestones and finished categories. Works with a finger on phones and tablets or with a mouse. Pictures: OpenMoji (CC BY-SA 4.0); maps: Natural Earth.
